summary_1line: Narada recounts performing a thousand-year vow to see Brahma’s indescribable celestial assembly where gods, sages, cosmic principles, and personified forces attend the Creator.

image_candidates.scene_text: Narada, after a thousand-year vow in the Himalayas, is led by the radiant sun-god Surya into Brahma’s blazing gem-like celestial assembly.
Inside Brahma’s palace of shifting light, countless gods, sages, planets, and personified virtues stand gathered around the Creator.
The self-effulgent hall of Brahma floats in heaven, shimmering with jewels and changing form as sun, moon, and fire seem dim beside it.
